highlights.title: Kosmos has its own iPad layouts
highlights.line: On an iPad held sideways, Agents and Projects open on One screen unless it chose Tabs; upright, Tabs puts agent cards two across.

highlights.title: Decision tasks say who needs you
highlights.line: A task in Needs Your Decision now names the agent waiting on you, when one is, and why, in the project page's words.

highlights.title: Kosmos restarts behind your app
highlights.line: When Kosmos restarts itself onto a new version while another app is in front, it now opens behind that app.

highlights.title: The Agents list fits a narrow window
highlights.line: In a narrow browser window, the Agents list shows each running agent's role and AI model under its name, not cut short.

highlights.title: Quiet runs of a recurring task roll up
highlights.line: Runs of a recurring task that found nothing new, or repeated the same note, fold into one row; its card says when something last changed.
